title: Stalkwise bijectivity of the affine symmetric algebra comparison
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $F$ a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module [pqf-def-coherent], $W$ an affine open, and $x\in\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O_X(W)$ [lem-weil-pbc-affine-open-spec-points]. Let $\alpha_W$ be the explicit tilde comparison of [def-weil-pbc-symmetric-algebra-affine-comparison-map]. Then the induced map on underlying abelian stalks $(\alpha_W)_x:(\widetilde{\operatorname{Sym}_{\mathcal O_X(W)}F(W)})_x\to(S|_{\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O_X(W)})_x$ is bijective. Here $S$ is the ring sheafification of the sectionwise symmetric algebra [lem-weil-pbc-symmetric-algebra-sheaf-construction], and stalk maps are colimits of the underlying abelian presheaf maps, as in [lem-weil-pbc-module-iso-on-stalks].

source.place: Algebra, Lemma 0C6F; Constructions, Lemma 01LN; Schemes, Lemma 01I8

proof.text: Put R = O_X(W), M = F(W), A = Sym_R(M), and restrict S to the affine chart. Affine neighbourhoods of each point inside W are cofinal. On each such smaller affine V, quasi-coherence gives F(V) = O_X(V) tensor_R M. Symmetric algebra base change gives a bijective map lambda_V : O_X(V) tensor_R A -> Sym_O_X(V)(F(V)), with r tensor a mapping to r times restriction(a). The tilde adjunction and tilde section base change give a bijective map beta_V to the sections of tilde(A), with r tensor a mapping to r tau_V(a).

source.place: Algebra, Lemma 0C6F; Constructions, Lemma 01LN; Schemes, Lemma 01I8

proof.text: The explicitly constructed alpha has alpha_V beta_V = theta_V lambda_V. First check this on 1 tensor a using affineComparison_toOpen and naturality of theta, and then extend by O_X(V)-linearity to all pure tensors and their sums. For Vprime contained in V, lambda and beta commute with restriction: on pure tensors both sides restrict r and a. Restriction to the affine chart does not change stalks at its points, since neighbourhoods inside W are cofinal.

source.place: Schemes, Lemmas 01I7 and 01I8; naturality on pure tensors

proof.text: The ring sheafification unit theta induces a bijection on underlying abelian stalks, because forgetting rings to abelian groups commutes with sheafification and the sheafification unit is an isomorphism on stalks. Lift a target germ through theta_x, represent it on an affine V inside W, and write that representative as lambda_V(c). The germ of beta_V(c) maps through alpha_x to the given target germ, proving surjectivity.

For injectivity, represent a source germ on an affine V as beta_V(c). If its alpha-image is zero, injectivity of theta_x implies the germ of lambda_V(c) is zero. Restrict to a smaller affine Vprime where it is zero. Restriction compatibility gives lambda_Vprime(cprime)=0; injectivity of lambda_Vprime implies cprime=0. Hence beta_Vprime(cprime)=0, so the original germ was zero. Apply this to the difference of two germs with equal alpha-image.

source.place: Modules, Lemma 01CH (lemma-stalk-tensor-algebra); equality of germs after shrinking

proof_origin.place: Modules, Lemmas 01CG and 01CH; Schemes, Lemmas 01I7 and 01I8. Explicit argument from the parent comparison plan, implemented using the tilde adjunction.
